name: google-sorting-demo
description: Source code (Python, Node.js and Java) for a demo we built which has been shown at a number of conferences, including IoT Solutions World Congress in Barcelona, Google Cloud Next 2019 and Google I/O 2019. Using the Coral Dev Board we show incredible fast machine learning on the edge with minimal power consumption.

paragraphs: This repo contains the source code for a demo we created to show off machine learning on the edge using the Coral Dev Board with the Edge TPU.
This is a video of it in action at the workshop where we were doing work on it just prior to Google Cloud Next 2019.

The source code is split into folders representing the different links in the architecture that piece together the whole thing. The demo uses a webcam, connected via USB-C to the Coral board, which is running a Python script pulling frames from the camera, and passing them through to our models. The models' output is then sent to a secondary machine (we had all them networked over a LAN with a router) which is running a Node.js script. That script does a few things:
features: Business logic for interpreting the model output and deciding which bucket the gear is dropped into.
Drives the Arduino which controls the mechanicals of the demo.
Sends telemetry data to a Cloud Firestore instance which is then picked up by the Dashboard.
